parameters.name: Bucket
parameters.description:
The storage space for the data. Default value: default. You can specify a custom value for business grouping and to avoid path conflicts.

> eci-system is a reserved space for ECI and cannot be used.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: EipCreateParam
parameters.description: The parameters for creating and associating an Elastic IP Address (EIP). If the VPC does not have a NAT gateway configured, you can associate an EIP to pull data from the Internet.

parameters.name: EipInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of an existing Elastic IP Address (EIP) to associate. If the VPC does not have a NAT gateway configured, you can associate an EIP to pull data from the Internet.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the data cache.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The path where the data is stored.

parameters.name: RetentionDays
parameters.description: The number of days to retain the data cache. The data cache is deleted after it expires. By default, the data cache does not expire.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the security group to which the ECI instance created during the data cache creation belongs.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: The size of the data cache. Unit: GiB. Default value: 20. Evaluate the required size based on the actual data volume.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags bound to the data cache.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the vSwitch to which the ECI instance created during the data cache creation belongs.
